thread.title: Apple Turns to Adobe to Enhance iPad Appeal

title: Apple Turns to Adobe to Enhance iPad Appeal
text: Apple Turns to Adobe to Enhance iPad Appeal More The full Photoshop package is coming to iPad next year, marking a major step for Apple (AAPL) in its effort to capitalize on the rise of enterprise mobility. Bloomberg reported in July that Adobe Systems (ADBE) was building a full version of its Photoshop software for the iPad as part of the effort to make its digital design software work on multiple device platforms. Adobe and fellow design software maker Autodesk (ADSK) have transitioned to selling most of their products on a subscription basis in which they book recurring revenue.
